title: YYC Advisors
description: YYC Advisors (YYC Group) is a long-established local accounting and comprehensive business consulting group in Malaysia, focusing on a "one-stop" service for tax + audit + business advisory. It mainly serves SMEs and growing companies and also deals with cross-border expansion, M&A succession, and digital software. 1. Basic Overview Founded: 1974, by Yap Seong Fatt, starting from a single table in Pudu, Kuala Lumpur Headquarters: No.32 & 34, Lorong Thambi 2, off Jalan Brunei, 55100 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; Phone: +603‑9078‑2868 Size: According to the official site, 1,100+ employees, serving 20,000+ clients, conducted 7,000+ training sessions; offices cover major Malaysian cities like Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Penang, Johor Bahru, as well as Singapore, and some sources mention Hong Kong Position: One of the top ten local accounting firms in Malaysia, with a focus on the SME market Capital background: In 2019, OCBC Bank invested in its non-audit business; later, it reached a strategic investment/growth partnership with Singapore's SeaTown Private Capital for professional services M&A expansion in Southeast Asia Website: yycadvisors.com 2. Core Services (by line) Tax: Corporate/personal tax compliance and planning, SST, transfer pricing, tax audits and investigation responses, Malaysia e-invoicing (MyInvois/e-Invoice) implementation Audit & Accounting: YYC & Co PLT licensed audit; outsourced bookkeeping, cloud accounting (Xero, etc.), financial statements, payroll outsourcing Corporate & Business Advisory: Company registration/company secretary, M&A, deal structuring, financial due diligence, business valuation, IPO support, internal audit, market research, business succession Digital Software: emplX (HR/payroll cloud), Smart New Retail (retail/F&B POS), cloud ERP related Training & Membership: Winning Strategy Academy, taxPOD (tax subscription/live streaming/micro-courses), for business owners and finance professionals ...,We've handled a total of 300GB of data, and here we show 6GB as proof.
